goal: Create a mock-backed asynchronous conversation service and UI for relationship correspondence, not realtime chat.

success_criteria.description: A typed conversation service returns inbox, thread, draft-reply, next-action, contact, event, and schedule context for the current test user without realtime transport or external sends.
GET /app/chat renders a usable inbox and selected thread with natural relationship correspondence tone, next actions, and scheduling context rather than stiff internal-company contact logs.
Conversation records in tests resolve to contacts, connections, events, and follow-up tasks; each selected thread exposes at least one concrete next action and one source context label.
The local reply or next-action preview route stages the action only and explicitly shows that no external message, notification, calendar entry, saved record, or network side effect occurred.
The mock-to-live replacement guidance documents the future live provider, privacy boundaries, no-send defaults, and replacement tests for asynchronous conversation storage.

out_of_scope: Adding realtime websocket chat, email sends, SMS sends, push notifications, or external CRM sync
Changing Orbit AI tool execution behavior
